rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for sunglasses.

example.english: Remember to wear sunglasses when you go out; the sun is really strong today.
example.traditional: 出街記得戴墨鏡，今日陽光好猛。
example.jyutping: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 mak6 geng3 gam1 jat6 joeng4 gwong1 hou2 maang5

rows.note: Pick this colloquial nickname for sunglasses, especially in casual conversation or when emphasizing a stylish look.

example.english: Those sunglasses of yours are pretty stylish.
example.jyutping: nei5 fu3 haak1 ciu1 gei2 jau5 jing4 wo3

rows.note: Use this transparent descriptive term when you want to make clear that the glasses are for sun protection.

example.english: The ultraviolet rays are so strong that it’s best to wear sunglasses.
example.traditional: 紫外線咁勁，最好戴太陽眼鏡。
example.jyutping: zi2 ngoi6 sin3 gam3 ging6 zeoi3 hou2 daai3 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng3

rows.note: Use this shorter sun-glasses term, which is more common in labels, product descriptions, and written contexts than in casual speech.

example.english: This pair of sunglasses is labelled as having UV protection.
example.traditional: 呢款太陽鏡標明有防紫外線功能。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 taai3 joeng4 geng3 biu1 ming4 jau5 fong4 zi2 ngoi6 sin3 gung1 nang4
